# miniz (vendored)

[miniz](https://github.com/richgel999/miniz) 3.1.2 (the release's amalgamated `miniz.c`/`miniz.h`,
`LICENSE` unchanged; MIT), for DEFLATE in the runtime: WebSocket permessage-deflate (#67), later
`CompressionStream`. Built with `MINIZ_NO_STDIO`, `MINIZ_NO_ARCHIVE_APIS`, `MINIZ_NO_TIME` and
`MINIZ_NO_ZLIB_COMPATIBLE_NAMES` (only the `mz_deflate`/`mz_inflate` streams are used).

Source: `miniz-3.1.2.zip` from the GitHub release, SHA-256
`f0446d863f9c19926ad9483c523fdc42e42b8d4a6a431d27e09d49c79a140d9a`.
